title: Cornfield Bomber
description: The pilot who once had to eject from his F-106 Delta Dart shares the story of how the jet managed to land itself safely in a Montana cornfield. Produced by Matthew Clouse at the National Museum of the United States Air Force at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio.
